summary: Frontend testing for GymAxis Memberships feature complete. All 16 test scenarios passed. Operator console at /memberships works with 4 tabs (Dashboard, Members, Timetable, Plans). Member portal at /members works with auth gate, login, registration, booking, cancellation, QR pass, and profile features.
seed_data_creation: Test members created during testing: register-frontend-test-8509@example.com, operator-added-4327@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: GymAxis Memberships frontend fully tested. Key findings: (1) Operator console at /memberships requires login via standard GymAxis auth, redirects to /pulse then navigate to /memberships, (2) Member portal at /members uses separate auth (member_token in localStorage), (3) All 4 operator tabs work: Dashboard (10 KPIs), Members (list with plan pills, detail drawer with Freeze/Cancel/Assign plan), Timetable (7-day grid with classes), Plans (4 seeded plans with prices), (4) Member portal tabs work: Book (weekly grid, book/cancel classes), Bookings (upcoming/past), Pass (rotating QR with 30s countdown), Profile (details + sign out), (5) Add member modal creates new members, (6) Registration flow creates new member accounts, (7) QR code API returns {code, expires_in, payload} for TOTP verification

operator_console: Login as studio.leeds@gymaxisai.com redirects to /pulse then /memberships works
Dashboard tab shows 10 KPI cards (Active members=4, New this month=4, etc.)
Members tab shows seeded members (Emma, Oliver, Sophia, Test Member) with plan pills
Member detail drawer shows current plan, Freeze/Cancel buttons, Assign new plan grid
Add member modal opens, form submits, member appears in list with 'Member added' toast
Timetable tab shows 7-column week grid with prev/next navigation
Seeded classes appear on correct days (HIIT Blast, Rhythm Ride, Strength Fundamentals)
Plans tab shows 4 seeded plans with colour accents and prices (£65, £650, £95, £15)
member_portal: Auth gate shows without token (GymAxis Member eyebrow, hero text, Sign in/Join tabs)
Member login with emma.wright@demo.gymaxis / Member2026! lands on Book tab
Bottom nav visible with Book/Bookings/Pass/Profile tabs
Book tab shows weekly grid with Emma's bookings (BOOKED pills, Cancel CTAs)
Clicking Book on unbooked class creates booking with 'Booked · <name>' toast
Clicking Cancel on booked class releases booking with 'Booking cancelled' toast
Bookings tab shows Upcoming and Past sections with status pills
Pass tab shows rotating QR code, 6-digit TOTP code, countdown timer
Profile tab shows Emma's details (name, email, phone, status=active, member since)
Sign out button logs out and returns to auth gate
Register flow creates new member account and lands on Book tab
